O oficial em cuja mão o rei se apoiava respondeu ao homem de Deus: “Mesmo que o SENHOR fizesse comportas nos céus, poderia acontecer tal coisa?” O homem de Deus disse: “Você verá isso com seus próprios olhos, mas não comerá disso.”

kjv.texto: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the Lord; what should I wait for the Lord any longer?

vizinhos.32: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?
